case: NULL-safe query parameters for domain-over-enum values
change: Exercise IS DISTINCT FROM and IS NOT DISTINCT FROM with both an enum label and SQL NULL against a domain-over-enum column cast to its base enum.
contract: PostgreSQL infers the bound parameter as the qualified base enum type for both null-safe distinctness operators.
The source column retains its domain type.
Text and SQL NULL parameters produce the exact expected per-row truth values, including NULL-safe equality semantics.
independent_oracle: Server-reported pg_typeof for the parameter and domain column plus exact PostgreSQL boolean results for ready, paused and SQL NULL rows.

domain_contract_suite.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration domain_contract:: -- --ignored --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Direct query contexts beyond the covered comparisons, lists, BETWEEN and NULL-safe distinctness operators remain open.
Session/search_path combinations, deeper nested-domain depths and other custom/native cases remain open.
This case does not close B3 or qualify the 0.2.0 release.
